_comment: Rival Hunters (game/rivals.py): other members of the Guild, world state like the city. They take contracts off the gate boards, bring finds home (sold through the workshop), sometimes beat you to a request or an odd job, level up, age, retire, die, and are remembered in the Hall of Hunters. Sometimes one takes the same contract as you: a race for the prize. User's choices: a small cast; all of the off-screen life; races; no fighting between Hunters. ALL NUMBERS, CALLINGS AND LINES ARE PLACEHOLDERS. color: how rivals look on the map (sky blue, to stand out from you (@), the townsfolk and the creatures). count: rivals at a time; new ones join (join_chance a Pulse) when there are fewer. start_levels: the cast at a new game. daily: the chance each Pulse that a rested rival at home takes a contract, fills a request, or takes an odd job. success/death: the chances for a hunt off-screen, from base + per_level x (level - 2 x danger), kept between low and high. xp_per_danger: experience for a successful hunt (the same level curve as yours). retire_from: [Turns, Judgments] after which each new Judgment has retire_chance of retiring (old age as for you: data/aging.json). race_chance: when you take a contract, the chance a rival at home goes after it too. race_turns: turns a rival needs per area: base - per_level x level, at least min. temperaments: how each kind greets you (used in data/dialogue/rival.json as {rival_greeting}).

boastful: Back already? I'd have had three artifacts by now.
Still alive, {given}? Good. Someone has to watch me work.
Ask me anything. I've seen it all, out there.
friendly: Sit, sit. How are you holding up?
Good to see a face I know.
wary: Careful out there, {given}. I mean it.
You look tired. We all do.

friendly: No hard feelings, {given}, but I'm getting there first!
wary: You too? Don't get yourself killed over it.
Let's not both die for one artifact.
